verification_note: issue #44: match/case, now implemented in BOTH the self-hosted toolchain (self_hosting/lib/{lexer,parser,lower}.patlang) and the native Rust frontend (rust-runtime/src/{ast,parser}.rs + ir/lowering.rs), as pure lowering-only sugar with zero new IR/Instr in either. Literal, wildcard/binding, comparison-guard, tagged-list (incl. nested), glob, when-guard, no-wildcard-no-match fatal-error, and a matched-arm-with-no-return fall-through all verified via self_hosting/tools/run_match_spec_suite.patlang (both through patc1.exe's lower+interpret and native pat.exe --ir-run/--build-run) and via self_hosting/examples/match_smoke.patlang compiled to a real native binary through patc1.exe. Full native `cargo test --release --test bdd` suite (46 passed/2 skipped, 0 failed) and self_hosting/build_patc1.patlang's own self-compile confirmed unaffected. Real bug found post-ship via a user report of the browser IDE hanging: self-hosted lower_match's end-of-match jump patching read its `endJumps` Vec back with list-style `.length`/`[i]` instead of `vec_len`/`vec_get`, silently patching zero jumps -- any matched arm with no `return` (previously untested) jumped back to instruction 0 instead of past the match, looping forever. Fixed and covered by the matched-arm-with-no-return scenario; native lowering.rs's typed `Vec<usize>` was never affected.
